# algolia_dictionary_entry (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a single custom Algolia dictionary entry (stopwords, plurals, or compounds).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_dictionary_entry" "example" {
  dictionary = "stopwords"
  language   = "en"
  word       = "the"
}

data "algolia_dictionary_entry" "example" {
  dictionary = algolia_dictionary_entry.example.dictionary
  object_id  = algolia_dictionary_entry.example.object_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dictionary` (String) Dictionary the entry belongs to. One of "stopwords", "plurals", or "compounds".
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the dictionary entry.

### Read-Only

- `decomposition` (List of String) Individual components of a compound word. Set for "compounds" entries.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <dictionary>/<object_id>.
- `language` (String) ISO code of the language the entry applies to.
- `state` (String) Whether the entry is active ("enabled" or "disabled").
- `word` (String) Matching dictionary word. Set for "stopwords" and "compounds" entries.
- `words` (List of String) Matching word forms, including declensions. Set for "plurals" entries.
